devdoc.details: Drop-in replacement for SimpleAttestationVerifier that supports a dynamic      witness set with a configurable signature threshold. Threshold defaults to 1      so the contract behaves as "any witness can sign" unless an owner raises it.

returns._0: True if the address is an authorized witness

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

returns.isValid: True if the witness threshold is met

devdoc.title: MultiAttestationVerifier

addWitness(address).notice: Adds a new witness to the authorized witness set

constructor.notice: Initializes the attestation verifier with an initial witness set and threshold

isWitness(address).notice: Returns whether an address is an authorized witness

removeWitness(address).notice: Removes a witness from the authorized witness set

setRequiredSignatures(uint256).notice: Updates the required witness signature threshold

verify(bytes32,bytes[],bytes).notice: Verifies attestation signatures against the current witness set

witnessCount().notice: Returns the current number of authorized witnesses

userdoc.notice: Verifies attestations from one of N authorized witness addresses
